review:
An 8x8 cluster game with a treasure map. Winning symbols leave coloured marks on the grid, forming a path that fills a feature meter – unlocking spin features like a Nuclear power that drops new symbols, and Lucky Wilds.

Reach Gold Fever and every modifier switches on at once, with a 10x multiplier at the final level. Progress comes from wins, not scatters, so long tumbles are rewarded. Up to 10,000x, 96.51% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
